Job description

Somos mais de 40 mil pessoas que atuam com foco em segurança, integridade, colaboração e simplificação, os pilares que sustentam nossa cultura.

Geramos valor para nossos acionistas, clientes e parceiros e colaboradores a partir de umecossistema integrado de negócios que começa com o cultivo da cana-de-açúcar até chegar na produção e comercialização de etanol, açúcar e bioenergia.

Atuamos ainda – sob licença da marca Shell – na distribuição de combustíveis, lubrificantes e outras especialidades no Brasil, além de operações de refino na Argentina e distribuição de derivados de combustíveis e lubrificantes na Argentina e no Paraguai.

Se identificou?

A área deGestão do Ciclo de Vida de Produtos (PLM) atua de forma transversal no negócio deLubrificantes , garantindo que o portfólio evolua estrategicamente para atender às demandas do mercado e às diretrizes globais daShell .

Você será o elo estratégico entre as áreas internas, Shell Global e parceiros externos para garantir uma gestão eficiente do ciclo de vida dos produtos, desde o lançamento até a descontinuação. Atuando como facilitador(a), assegurará o alinhamento entre inovação, portfólio e operação, monitorando KPIs críticos, otimizando estoques e implementando melhorias contínuas. Seu papel será essencial para impulsionar a competitividade da empresa, garantindo prazos, compliance e a execução de iniciativas estratégicas no mercado.

Jornada de Trabalho: 5 dias por semana - seg. à sex.

Horário : Adm. – 09h às 18h

Local : Ilha do Governador, RJ - Raízen Lubrificantes


Main responsibilities

COMO SERÁ O SEU DIA A DIA:

  • Gerenciar projetos de lançamento e descontinuação de produtos, garantindo o alinhamento entre todas as áreas envolvidas.
  • Liderar a interface entre Shell Global e stakeholders internos, assegurando a execução eficiente de iniciativas de inovação e portfólio.
  • Atuar como facilitador entre diferentes áreas da empresa e parceiros externos, garantindo aderência a prazos e processos.
  • Gerenciar e atualizar KPIs estratégicos, incluindo Time to Market, Saúde do Portfólio, Obsolescência e aderência ao Plano de Portfólio.
  • Monitorar estoques de produtos de baixo giro e/ou descontinuados, promovendo ações para otimizar o portfólio.
  • Capturar oportunidades de melhoria contínua, identificando boas práticas e soluções inovadoras para fortalecer a gestão do ciclo de vida de produtos.
  • Ser o ponto focal no desenvolvimento de labels e embalagens, atuando em conjunto com o time da Shell Global.
  • Atuar na revisão dos processos com foco em eficiência e simplificação.

Requirements and skills

O QUE VOCÊ PRECISA TER:

  • Ensino Superior completo.
  • Inglês Avançado – necessário para interações frequentes com a Shell Global.
  • Capacidade analítica e organização na construção e gestão de processos.
  • Experiência prévia em gestão de projetos.
  • Habilidades digitais (Power BI, programação).
  • Forte capacidade de interlocução e gestão de stakeholders.
  • Mentalidade de melhoria contínua e capacidade de propor soluções inovadoras.
  • Poder de influência para articular demandas entre diferentes áreas e níveis hierárquicos.

Additional information

ETAPAS DO PROCESSO SELETIVO:

Nosso processo contempla 3 etapas principais (podem ter outras, e você ficará por dentro caso avance):

  1. Inscrição - preenchimento deste formulário e de dados adicionais, caso necessário.
  2. Entrevista com o RH - um bate-papo para nos conhecermos.
  3. Entrevista com a liderança: bate-papo mais técnico para contar ainda mais sobre o dia a dia e os desafios.

Nossa comunicação será por e-mail e telefone - confira se seus dados estão atualizados.

title: Senior Event Controller FIFA Women’s World Cup 2027TM
description:
FIFA27 will be established as the Local FIFA Subsidiary in Brazil, to work together with FIFA HQ in Zurich and globally, to deliver the biggest women’s sporting event in the world, the FIFA Women’s World Cup 2027 (“FWWC2027”).

Please submit your CV in English, as it will be reviewed by an international team.

Job Description

The position

Under the responsibility of the FIFA27 Head of Finance and in collaboration with the FIFA Finance division in Zurich, the Senior Event Controller will drive in Brazil the budget and forecast process throughout the FIFA Women’s World Cup 2027 project lifecycle providing finance business partnering and support to the various budget owners and to FIFA27 senior management.
Key responsibilities

  • Assist with the preparation of the FIFA Women’s World Cup 2027budget, for the period 2025-2027, which captures all the operational costs to ensure the successful delivery of the tournament.
  • Assist with the implementation of the FIFA budgeting and reporting tools and organize hands-on training with the budget owners in Brazil.
  • Prepare cash flow forecast requirements in connection with the Brazilian operational budget.
  • Lead in Brazil the financial planning and budget review processes working closely with the FIFA Senior Event Controller (based in Zurich) and with all budget owners (Zurich and Brazil based).
  • Work closely with the FIFA Senior Event Controller, to implement FIFA Finance processes in Brazil and to support a smooth consolidation of the full tournament operational budgets.
  • Present the outcome of the quarterly forecast exercise as well as recommended corrective actions (when necessary) to the various stakeholders.
  • Coordinate the accrual process at year-end supporting the FIFA Zurich and FIFA27 Accounting teams and the various budget owners.
  • Review monthly cost allocations to various project codes and prepare re-allocation journals when required.
  • Prepare monthly management reports providing insightful commentary for budget owners and senior management.
  • Monitor and maintain monthly cash flow forecasts, reflecting the Brazilian operational budget, to ensure the liquidity needs of FIFA27 are met.
  • Perform ad-hoc analysis and prepare additional financial reports as requested by the Head of Finance and senior management.

Your profile

  • Bachelor’s degree in Finance, Accounting, Economics, or related field.
  • Minimum 5 years of experience in accounting and Financial Planning & Analysis.
  • Experience in an event organization in a financial role (organizing major sport events or other similar projects).
  • Advanced knowledge and experience with budgeting and reporting tools.
  • Experience in preparing financial statements, preferably in a multi-entity environment.
  • Experience in an international environment.
  • Experience in procurement of advantage.
  • SAP experience preferred.
  • Well-developed organisational skills with an ability to prioritize your workload and meet strict deadlines.
  • Business fluent in English, any other language is an asset.
  • Excellent written and verbal communication skills to facilitate business partnering.
  • Have a proactive hands-on approach to problem solving – a ‘can do’ attitude.
  • Strong attention to detail and a focus on quality and accuracy.
  • Well-versed in Microsoft Office Excel, Word & Powerpoint presentation.
  • Ability to work independently and with a team in a fast-paced and high-volume environment.
  • Right to work in Brazil.
  • Ability to re-locate to Rio de Janeiro.

About FIFA Women’s World Cup 2027

The FIFA Women’s World Cup is the greatest women’s sporting event on the planet, showcasing the best players in the world on the biggest stage. In 2027, history will be made as Brazil welcomes the tournament to South America for the first time ever.

This landmark event will unite the world through an unprecedented celebration of women’s football, inspiring billions of fans across the globe. As we prepare to host teams and supporters from every corner of the world, we’re looking for passionate, talented individuals to be part of history and help deliver an unforgettable tournament.

Join us and play your role in making FIFA Women’s World Cup 2027 a truly extraordinary experience that celebrates and elevates women’s football.

Do you want to make an impact and drive the growth of a global brand? We are looking for aRegional Sales Manager to join our LATAM team, based in Rio de Janeiro, Brazil .

In this role, you will report to the Divisional Sales Manager, leading sales and operations for ourConcept Stores, SIS, Kiosk and multi-branded POS within your assigned area . You will be at the forefront of ensuring exceptional customer experiences, driving sales growth, and safeguarding the brand image in every store you oversee.

What you’ll do:

  • Stimulate sales growth and maximize volume and profitability using all available tools.
  • Implement sales standards, leading by example and inspiring the teams.
  • Monitor sales objectives and KPIs set by the Divisional Sales Manager and Sales Director.
  • Analyze business results and implement agile corrective actions when needed.
  • Identify and pursue local business opportunities across all channels.

Operations & Execution

  • Visit stores regularly to ensure image, order, and operational excellence.
  • Coordinate promotional and sales activities in collaboration with Marketing.
  • Oversee effective planning and execution of new store openings.
  • Cultivate strong relationships with wholesale customers and franchise partners.

Stock Management

  • Monitor stock availability through stocktakes and ensure alignment with sales goals.
  • Train teams on top sellers, new stock, basics, and strategies to optimize inventory turnover.

People & Talent Development

  • Develop internal talent and promote a high-performance culture through coaching and motivation.
  • Provide regular feedback and training to empower teams to deliver an excellent customer experience.
  • Lead by example, inspiring passion for the product and brand.
  • Ensure flawless execution of marketing plans and VM standards.
  • Train store teams on effective VM maintenance and share best practices with the VM team.
  • Deliver on-the-job training in sales processes, product knowledge, customer service, policies, and procedures.
  • Support store teams in achieving key business targets.

Budget & Financial Management

  • Monitor and analyze sales vs. budget on an ongoing basis.
  • Oversee employment costs and time coverage for assigned stores.

Third Party Relationship Management

  • Build and maintain strong relationships with franchisees, store owners, and employees.
  • Collaborate effectively with all departments to drive business results.

What you bring:

  • 4-5 years of experience in regional sales roles, managing retail and wholesale, with strong focus on Operations and Development.
  • Proven expertise in retail strategies, project management, and business analysis.
  • Strong financial knowledge linked to retail (budget management, P&L interpretation).
  • Mastery of MS Office (Word, Excel, PowerPoint).
  • Excellent interpersonal, communication, and leadership skills.
  • Strategic mindset with a passion for problem-solving and driving results.
  • Strong organizational skills with the ability to manage multiple priorities in a fast-paced environment.
  • Advanced English.
  • Willingness to travel80%+ of the time across your region.

If you see yourself in this role and want to be part of Pandora’s future, we encourage you to apply. We process applications on a continuous basis, so don’t wait to submit yours.

Pandora is the world's largest jewellery brand, specialising in the design, crafting and marketing of accessible luxury jewellery made from high-quality materials. Each piece is created to inspire self-expression, allowing people to share their stories and passions through meaningful jewellery. Pandora jewellery is sold in more than 100 countries through 6,800 points of sale, including more than 2,700 concept stores.

Headquartered in Copenhagen, Denmark, Pandora employs 37,000 people worldwide and crafts its jewellery using only recycled silver and gold. Pandora is committed to leadership in sustainability and has set out to halve greenhouse gas emissions across its value chain by 2030. Pandora is listed on the Nasdaq Copenhagen stock exchange and generated revenue of DKK 31.7 billion (EUR 4.2 billion) in 2024.

Recognised by the Financial Times as one of Europe’s Best Workplaces and ranked #1 among Danish companies, Pandora is committed to building an inclusive and diverse workplace. We believe that reflecting the diversity of society in how we engage with our customers is essential to fulfilling our purpose: to give a voice to people’s loves. We are dedicated to nurturing a culture where everyone feels respected, valued, and empowered to thrive.

Engenheiro Sênior de Projetos Estruturais | Energia Solar

Job type: Full-time employee Full-time employee

Estamos em busca de alguém motivado a abraçar responsabilidades e que goste de trabalhar com autonomia. Alguém que queira fazer a diferença e enfrentar desafios junto com uma equipe determinada a transformar o mercado de energia no Brasil.

Aqui na Órigo Energia você terá oportunidades de crescimento profissional e usará a sua energia para impactar positivamente o mundo.

Além disso, reconhecemos e valorizamos a diversidade de perspectivas, experiências e identidades que nossos colaboradores trazem para o ambiente de trabalho.

Nesse contexto acreditamos firmemente que a inclusão é a chave para um crescimento sustentável, e para a manutenção e fortalecimento de uma cultura verdadeiramente enriquecedora.

Não fazemos distinção entre candidatos, seja por gênero, deficiência, orientação sexual, raça/etnia ou idade. Por aqui, a sua competência vem acima de qualquer outro ponto!

Se você se identifica com esse perfil, candidate-se agora mesmo e seja parte de uma equipe dinâmica, colaborativa, criativa e inovadora.

Missão da Posição

Atuar como referência técnica no desenvolvimento e implantação de soluções estruturais e sistemas de drenagem em usinas fotovoltaicas (UFVs), liderando frentes de projeto e execução, com foco em padronização, qualidade, inovação e performance operacional.

️ Responsabilidades e Atividades

  • Desenvolver e validar metodologias de cálculo e roteiros técnicos para dimensionamento estrutural e sistemas de drenagem aplicáveis a usinas solares.
  • Garantir excelência técnica e cumprimento dos prazos dos projetos, assegurando entregas em conformidade com os padrões da Companhia.
  • Liderar, planejar e monitorar as atividades de backoffice, garantindo alinhamento e integração entre as equipes administrativas e operacionais.
  • Coordenar equipes de campo, realizando a distribuição de responsabilidades, orientação técnica e acompanhamento de desempenho.
  • Realizar análises técnicas de projetos estruturais (fundações, terraplenagem e drenagem), avaliando viabilidade técnica, segurança e conformidade normativa.
  • Acompanhar a execução dos projetos em campo, garantindo a correta aplicação das soluções e promovendo a melhoria contínua.
  • Implementar inovações tecnológicas e metodológicas que contribuam com a eficiência e a evolução dos processos de construção de UFVs.
  • Zelar pela segurança e saúde ocupacional, garantindo aderência às normas regulatórias e aos padrões internos da Companhia.
  • Monitorar cronogramas físicos e financeiros, propondo ajustes técnicos e operacionais sempre que necessário.
  • Identificar riscos, desvios e não conformidades, estruturando planos de ação corretiva e preventiva.

Requisitos e Qualificações

  • Formação superior completa em Engenharia Civil.
  • Experiência consolidada em projetos e obras no setor de energia solar (UFVs) .
  • Sólidos conhecimentos em dimensionamento estrutural , terraplenagem e drenagem .
  • Vivência em execução de obras , gestão de equipes técnicas e acompanhamento de performance em campo.
  • Domínio de ferramentas como AutoCAD, Civil 3D, Excel avançado, MS Project e softwares de cálculo estrutural.
  • Conhecimento de normas técnicas aplicáveis (ABNT, NBR, NR's).
  • Desejável: pós-graduação em Engenharia Estrutural, Energias Renováveis ou Gestão de Projetos.
  • Step 3: Entrevista com o RH 3 Entrevista com o RH

Aqui na Órigo Energia, a nossa paixão pela energia renovável é genuína! Somos pioneiros no Brasil quando se trata de construir Usinas Fotovoltaicas para Geração Distribuída, ou, como gostamos de chamar, Fazendas Solares. Nossa expertise está em aproveitar ao máximo o sol abundante do nosso país, gerando energia limpa com muito orgulho!

Nosso objetivo é proporcionar acesso, informação e oportunidades para todos. Queremos tornar a energia renovável uma realidade ao alcance de todos os brasileiros, não importa onde vivam. Nossa meta é permitir que cada pessoa participe ativamente da transição para um futuro mais sustentável e ambientalmente responsável.

A nossa história fala por si só. Com mais de 12 anos de experiência no mercado, os últimos três foram dedicados integralmente às nossas Fazendas Solares. Atualmente, temos mais de 100 Fazendas Solares em pleno funcionamento e outras em construção ou em processo de conexão. Já ajudamos mais de 80 mil clientes a economizarem mais de R$ 100 milhões em suas contas de luz. Além disso, com a energia que geramos, contribuímos para evitar a emissão de mais de 200mil toneladas de CO2 na atmosfera.

Diariamente, moldamos a empresa que desejamos ser com paixão e propósito, e fazemos parte de um movimento global que usa o poder dos negócios para promover o bem. Nosso compromisso com a sustentabilidade e a responsabilidade social é absoluto. O futuro sustentável está em curso neste exato momento, e é com orgulho que estamos contribuindo para torná-lo realidade!

Ao fazer parte de nossa equipe, você passa a integrar uma organização com mais de 1.900 colaboradores, com presença em todo o país.

Conheça a nossa história e cultura

Você já entrou em um lugar pela primeira vez e logo de cara se sentiu em casa? Bom, é essa sensação que a Toledo do Brasil quer proporcionar a todos os colaboradores.Você pode não saber, mas com certeza já conhece um pouco a empresa : talvez tenha visto um de nossos produtos em uma padaria, enquanto espera os frios serem fatiados e pesados; no supermercado; na estrada; ou até mesmo naquela rápida parada na farmácia. Lembrou? Sim, sem dúvida você já viu um desses produtos espalhados por todo o Brasil ou América Latina.

Agora, o que você talvez não saiba ainda é que nós somos muito mais que balança .Hoje somos reconhecidos como uma empresa de tecnologia, que desenvolve softwares, cria plataformas de produtos e serviços em cloud e revende etiquetas eletrônicas e fatiadores de carne e frios.

E se você soubesse agora que, além de investir em alta tecnologia e inovação, a empresa em que você pretende trabalhar promove para seus colaboradores festivais de música em local e com equipamentos profissionais, campeonatos de videogame que mais parecem reunião entre amigos, que possui o “Espaço Mulher” dedicado às colaboradoras, com ótima infraestrutura para prestação de serviços, eventos e descanso e que, também realiza campeonato de futebol em quadra society, com arbitragem profissional e com churrasco e cerveja na grande final? Calma, ainda não acabou! E se dissessem ainda, que a Toledo do Brasil incentiva que seus colaboradores participem de eventos culturais , fornecendo ingressos gratuitos para orquestras, teatros e concertos internacionais no Brasil.

Imaginou? Então vamos lá! Queremos te convidar a fazer parte dessa grande família e, como em toda a família, a sinceridade e transparência são os principais pilares. Bom, antes de dizer como fazer parte desta família, gostaríamos de ressaltar que a empresa tem mais de 60 anos de história. Fundada em 1956, a empresa sempre esteve em processo de transformação de sua cultura organizacional, de seus produtos e de sua marca para acompanhar a grande e bem-vinda evolução da sociedade. E para que essa evolução seja ainda melhor e mais completa, gostaríamos de contar com o seu apoio, com as suas histórias, com as suas experiências e com seu conhecimento para tornar o ambiente interno cada vez mais interessante, inteligente e familiar.

Então, agora que já conhece um pouco sobre a Toledo do Brasil, coloque tudo na balança e entre nessa jornada! Afinal, aqui não te faltarão desafios, aprendizados, interação e conquistas com as diversas áreas da empresa.

title: Técnico de AC/Refrigeração Sênior
description:
Técnico de AC/Refrigeração Sênior

Estamos em busca de um Técnico de Refrigeração com foco marítimo que vai atuar na instalação, comissionamento, manutenção e reparo de chillers, plantas de provisão, unidades de refrigeração e sistemas HVAC especificamente projetados para ambientes marítimos. Este papel exige um conhecimento profundo de sistemas de refrigeração complexos e uma forte habilidade para gerenciar os desafios técnicos únicos dos sistemas de refrigeração.

Responsabilidades Principais:

  • Instalar, comissionar e manter chillers industriais, plantas de refrigeração de provisão e sistemas HVAC em embarcações marítimas e em instalações marítimas;

  • Realizar manutenção rotineira e de emergência em sistemas de refrigeração e ar condicionado, garantindo que operem com eficiência máxima e atendam aos padrões ambientais e de segurança;

  • Diagnosticar e resolver problemas complexos em uma variedade de sistemas, focando em chillers e unidades de refrigeração, enquanto mantém proficiência com componentes de sistemas HVAC;

  • Reformar compressores e outros componentes críticos dentro desses sistemas, melhorando sua confiabilidade e desempenho;

  • Colaborar com engenheiros marítimos para otimizar layouts e cronogramas de refrigeração, minimizando o tempo de inatividade e a interferência operacional;

  • Manter documentação precisa e detalhada de todos os procedimentos técnicos, modificações de sistemas e verificações de conformidade;

  • Fornecer orientação e treinamento especializados para técnicos juniores, enfatizando as especificidades de chillers, plantas de provisão e sistemas de refrigeração em um contexto marítimo;

  • Manter-se atualizado com os avanços tecnológicos em sistemas de refrigeração marítima e HVAC, integrando novas técnicas e equipamentos em estruturas existentes.

Requisitos:

  • Experiência como Técnico de Refrigeração com conhecimento especializado em refrigeração, incluindo chillers, plantas de provisão e unidades de refrigeração em grande escala;

  • Proficiência na instalação, comissionamento, diagnóstico de problemas e reforma de sistemas de refrigeração complexos, com experiência adicional em tecnologias HVAC;

  • Certificações relevantes em Refrigeração e HVAC, com treinamento ou certificações adicionais voltadas para aplicações marítimas, são preferidas;

  • Fortes habilidades técnicas, incluindo a capacidade de interpretar esquemas detalhados e manuais operacionais específicos para sistemas de refrigeração e HVAC marítimos;

  • Habilidades excepcionais de resolução de problemas, com foco na resolução rápida e eficiente de questões técnicas em ambientes marítimos desafiadores;

  • Inglês intermediário, será um diferencial;

  • Disposição para viajar por longos períodos, se necessário;

  • Proficiência na utilização de ferramentas como MS Office ( Word, Excel) para realização de relatórios técnicos e de serviço.

Condições de Trabalho:

Este papel exige trabalhar em variados ambientes marítimos, que podem ser fisicamente exigentes e às vezes perigosos. Os técnicos precisam se adaptar às condições restritas e dinâmicas encontradas em navios e instalações portuárias. Horários de trabalho flexíveis, incluindo possíveis turnos noturnos e de fim de semana, são frequentemente necessários para acomodar os cronogramas operacionais dos clientes marítimos.

Nossa Cultura
Por aqui, vivemos nossa cultura no dia a dia, guiados por esses 5 pilares:
Own It: Ter espírito de dono te faz conquistar a liberdade. Valorizamos a autonomia e a proatividade, somos responsáveis pelo o que entregamos e queremos sempre evoluir o nosso negócio.
Live the Ride: Faça. Feito é melhor que perfeito. Aprendemos com os erros e encaramos desafios como oportunidades de aprendizado.
No Bullshit: Agir com simplicidade. Somos pessoas práticas, sinceras e gostamos de feedbacks. Sabemos que às vezes vamos errar e contamos com essa transparência para evoluirmos.
Team Play: Se quer ir rápido, vá sozinho(a). Se quer ir longe, trabalhe em equipe. É sempre possível aprender com as outras pessoas e a colaboração é a chave do sucesso.
The Reason: O cliente não tem razão, ele é a razão. Nos motivamos a enxergar o impacto do nosso trabalho na vida do cliente, é vendo que melhoramos a vida dele que sabemos que fizemos uma boa entrega.
Como é Ser Uma Pessoa Software Engineer Go Senior
Procuramos uma pessoa desenvolvedora apaixonada por desafios, tecnologia e conhecimento. Essa pessoa, junto ao time, será responsável por:

  • Atuar no desenvolvimento e manutenção de novas funcionalidades;

At Lumenalta, we create impactful software solutions that drive innovation and transform businesses. Since 2000, we’ve partnered with visionary leaders to build cutting-edge tech, solve complex challenges, and deliver results faster through our elite teams and tech-driven approach. Join us in shaping the future of marketing technology.

Role Overview

We’re looking for a MarTech Solutions Architect with deep expertise in customer data platforms (CDP), data integration, and cross-channel activation. This role will lead the design and implementation of a centralized hub-and-spoke data model, ensuring unified data collection, identity resolution, and privacy-first activation across marketing and analytics channels.

You will partner with marketing, product, engineering, and analytics teams to design scalable data layers, implement event schemas, and connect systems like Braze, paid media platforms, and analytics tools. Your work will empower lifecycle marketing, personalization, and advanced segmentation to drive growth and customer engagement.

Key Responsibilities

  • Architect & implement CDP (hub/spoke model): Design the framework for centralized data collection, processing, and distribution across channels.
  • Integrations & activation: Connect CDP with Braze, analytics platforms, and paid media channels for seamless campaign orchestration.
  • Unified data layer & event schema: Define and manage standardized event tracking and attributes across app/web touchpoints.
  • Audience management: Enable audience creation, segmentation, and activation for lifecycle marketing campaigns.
  • Tracking & attribution: Configure deep link tracking and campaign tactics (upsell, cross-sell, retention) with server-side attributes.
  • Identity resolution & consent management: Ensure compliance with privacy regulations (GDPR, CCPA, CASL) while maintaining accurate user identity stitching across devices/channels.
  • Collaboration & enablement: Partner with data, engineering, and marketing teams to align schemas, troubleshoot issues, and ensure data quality.

Qualifications

  • 7+ years of experience in MarTech, CDP, or marketing data engineering/architecture.
  • Hands-on experience implementing and managing CDPs (e.g., Segment, mParticle, Adobe RT-CDP, Salesforce CDP, Tealium AudienceStream).
  • Strong knowledge of event tracking, tag management, and data layer design.
  • Proven expertise integrating Braze, marketing automation, analytics, and paid media platforms.
  • Understanding of identity resolution frameworks, consent management, and privacy-first data practices.
  • Experience with SQL, BigQuery, or similar for data validation and reporting.
  • Strong communicator who can translate technical architectures into actionable marketing strategies.

Desired Expertise in Platforms

  • CDPs: Segment, mParticle, Adobe RT-CDP, Salesforce CDP, Tealium AudienceStream.
  • Lifecycle Marketing: Braze (preferred), Iterable, Salesforce Marketing Cloud.
  • Analytics & Data: GA4, BigQuery, Tableau, Snowflake.
  • Privacy/Consent: OneTrust, TrustArc, or equivalent.

Com sede em Esteio/RS e na região Paulista/PE, também operando com um Centro de Distribuição em Araçariguama/SP, há mais de 75 anos, a InBetta, através de suas unidades de negócio, fabrica uma ampla linha de produtos em diferentes segmentos, sendo referência nos seus mercados de atuação.

Se você também acredita que a criatividade facilita a vida, confira as oportunidades disponíveis.

Descrição da Empresa

Nossa empresa é criativa, inquieta, de olho no futuro e pronta para fazer o novo. O seu nome é a tradução disso. O “In” significa o constante; “Betta”, a transformação.

Uma empresa que reúne grandes empresas e que produz 4.500 produtos diferentes, totalizando cerca de 50.000.000 de unidades por mês, comercializados em todo o Brasil e exportados para mais de 50 países. São mais de 3.000 profissionais trabalhando para facilitar a vida das pessoas através de sua principal matéria-prima: a criatividade.

Atualmente, a corporação tem empresas que atuam em segmentos diferentes: higiene e beleza, organização, conservação, limpeza, acabamento e pintura de superfícies, linha profissional. Cada empresa possui suas próprias marcas de produtos e tem liberdade de atuação em seus mercados, mas todas seguem os conceitos corporativos da InBetta.

Ao ingressar na rede Buddha Spa, o profissional técnico passa por um importante processo de imersão, treinamento e preparação para estar apto a atuar no padrão de excelência da marca. Estas etapas envolvem:
• Apresentação de boas-vindas e introdução ao mercado de bem-estar;
• 104 horas de treinamento inicial de padronização e direcionamento nos protocolos técnicos, rituais de atendimento, treinamentos sobre produtos utilizados na experiência do cliente e direcionamento estratégico dos atendimentos em um centro de treinamento renomado Buddha College;

O Buddha Spa reconhece e valoriza todos os profissionais técnicos e parceiros da rede. Periodicamente realizamos premiações de desempenho e reconhecimentos, com viagens, experiências, passeios, restaurantes e participação em eventos/campeonatos internacionais do setor.

Vem ser Buddha!

O Buddha Spa é a maior rede de Spas Urbanos do país, com unidades em diversas cidades e estados. Nossas unidades estão localizadas em imóveis de rua, dentro de hotéis, condomínios, shoppings, salões e academias, sempre buscando nos aproximar de nossos clientes.
Com foco em serviços de bem-estar, relaxamento e estética, oferecemos mais de 25 tipos de terapias, desde massagens corporais, banhos, tratamentos estéticos avançados, Day Spas, além de procedimentos exclusivamente voltados para o público masculino, gestantes e pós-parto.
A essência do trabalho do Buddha Spa se assenta nos valores do “sentir-se bem”, em todos os aspectos. Buscamos entregar a nossos clientes muito mais do que o atendimento técnico de cada serviço, propiciando uma experiência única. O despertar dos 5 sentidos é a base do atendimento de nossos clientes, os quais usufruem de uma infra-estrutura de alto padrão totalmente voltada para o bem-estar: sons, aromas e chás complementam o toque profissional de cada um de nossos terapeutas.

description:
Embedded HW Developer (processor + FPGA)

Join to apply for the Embedded HW Developer (processor + FPGA) role at TechnipFMC

Embedded HW Developer (processor + FPGA)

Join to apply for the Embedded HW Developer (processor + FPGA) role at TechnipFMC

TechnipFMC is committed to driving real change in the energy industry. Our ambition is to build a sustainable future through relentless innovation and global collaboration – and we want you to be part of it. You’ll be joining a culture that values curiosity, expertise, and ideas as well as diversity, inclusion, and authenticity. Bring your unique energy to our team of more than 20,000 people worldwide, and discover a rewarding, fulfilling, and varied career that you can take in anywhere you want to go.
Job Purpose
About Us: At TechnipFMC, within the Controls & Automation product line, we are pioneering technology platforms for the electrification of Subsea Control Systems and the advancement of renewable energy sources such as offshore wind, hydrogen, and wave energy.
Our Team : The Electronics R&D team works across a broad spectrum of technologies, including analog electronics, FPGA, SoC, power design, safety design, motor controllers, processor design, and power line modems. These technologies are integral to various control system applications.
Your Role: As part of the Controls & Automation team at TechnipFMC, you will engage in the design, development, qualification, system integration, and production of new products into commissioning and field operation. Our multidisciplinary development environment includes HW, SW, system, test, mechatronics, and production engineering teams working collaboratively.
We are seeking Senior Embedded Hardware Developers with expertise in embedded systems and hardware design to join our Hardware development team.
Job Description

  • Define hardware requirements in collaboration with system architects, SW architects, product owners
  • Design and develop embedded hardware circuits, PCBAs, FPGA modules, including component selection, schematic drawing, PCB layout, and prototype building.
  • Conduct functional verification of embedded hardware circuits, PCBAs, FPGA modules, electronic sub-assemblies.
  • Collaborate with systems architects, mechanical designers, PCB layout, manufacturing, reliability, and SW engineering teams to design and develop embedded hardware products.
  • Create test and verification procedures and write test reports on functional, environmental, system operation mode, and manufacturing testing of custom embedded hardware designs.
You Are Meant For This Job If
  • Expertise in digital electronic design including high speed, serial communication interfaces (CAN, RSXXX, I2C, SPI, USB), control, processor, network interface design on SoC platforms.
  • Extended understanding of Central Processing Units, microcontrollers, embedded software and signal processing techniques
  • Advanced knowledge of VHDL and FPGA design and verification methodologies.
  • Experience of LT SPICE, MATLAB, Simulink, Python, and Intel (Altera) Quartus
  • Knowledge of C, C++, assembly language or other embedded software languages
  • Schematic design and PCB layout using ECAD tools like Altium Designer or equivalent.
  • Experience with lab instruments such as oscilloscopes, logic analyzers, network analyzers, communication analyzers, signal generators, and simulators.
  • Expertise in PCB layout for optimal component placement, reduced stray inductance/capacitance, improved manufacturability, and EMC compliance.
  • Experience in embedded hardware design optimized for DFX requirements (manufacturability and testability).
  • Understanding of EMC requirements and CE certification relevant to embedded controller design in control system applications.
  • Knowledge and experience of safety and reliability standards including IEC61508
Qualifications
  • BSc, MSc, or PhD in electronics, automation, cybernetics, or a related engineering field.
  • 3-5 years of industrial experience in relevant embedded hardware development and industrialization.
  • Ability to approach complex problems structurally.
  • Open-minded, professional English proficiency, and adaptability to work in a multicultural environment.
  • Continuously raising standards, innovative, and solution oriented.
  • Interest in electronics is an additional advantage.
What We Offer
  • Exciting global R&D environment.
  • Engaging tasks and work-life balance.
  • Flexible working arrangements.
  • State-of-the-art development environment.
  • Training and career development opportunities.
  • Comprehensive insurance and pension plans.

Being a global leader in the energy industry requires an inclusive and diverse environment. TechnipFMC promotes diversity, equity, and inclusion by ensuring equal opportunities to all ages, races, ethnicities, religions, sexual orientations, gender expressions, disabilities, or all other pluralities. We celebrate who you are and what you bring. Every voice matters and we encourage you to add to our culture.


TechnipFMC respects the rights and dignity of those it works with and promotes adherence to internationally recognized human rights principles for those in its value chain.

A Dadoteca é uma empresa inovadora no setor de tecnologia, dedicada a fornecer soluções de alta qualidade para nossos clientes através de um ambiente de trabalho colaborativo e que impulsiona o desenvolvimento.
Atividades:

  • Projetar e implementar modelos de OCR utilizando frameworks e bibliotecas avançadas para remoção de dados de documentos estruturados e não estruturados.
  • Analisar, preparar e pré-processar grandes volumes de dados textuais para uso em modelos de aprendizado de máquina e deep learning.
  • Desenvolver pipelines de processamento de dados, incluindo a remoção, transformação e armazenamento dos resultados OCR.
  • Integrar soluções de OCR com outras ferramentas e sistemas para automatizar fluxos de trabalho e processos de análise de dados.
  • Realizar treinamentos e ajustes finos em modelos de OCR para melhorar as correções em cenários específicos, como idiomas, fontes, formatos e ruídos.
  • Explorar e aplicar técnicas de PNL (Processamento de Linguagem Natural) para enriquecer a análise e categorização dos textos extraídos.
  • Colaborar com equipes multidisciplinares para garantir a integração das soluções de OCR em projetos maiores de análise de dados.
  • Monitorar e melhorar o desempenho dos modelos de OCR em produção, garantindo sua escalabilidade e confiabilidade.
  • Pesquisar novas tecnologias e tecnologias relacionadas a OCR e inteligência artificial, mantendo-se atualizado com as tendências do setor.

Requisitos:
  • Formação superior em Ciência da Computação, Engenharia, Matemática, Estatística ou áreas correlatas. Pós-graduação ou especialização em áreas de IA ou Ciência de Dados é desejável.
  • Experiência consolidada em projetos de ciência de dados, com foco em OCR e processamento de imagens.
  • Conhecimento avançado em frameworks de deep learning, como TensorFlow, PyTorch ou Keras.
  • Experiência com bibliotecas de OCR, como Tesseract, Google Vision, AWS Textract, ABBYY FineReader, ou similares.
  • Habilidade com técnicas de pré-processamento de imagens (OpenCV ou PIL) para melhorar a qualidade dos documentos antes da análise.
  • Conhecimento em linguagens de programação como Python ou R, com foco em aplicações de ciência de dados.
  • Familiaridade com bancos de dados relacionais e não relacionais para armazenamento e consulta de dados textuais.
  • Experiência com ferramentas de versionamento de código (Git) e práticas de MLOps.

Competências:
  • Capacidade de traduzir problemas de negócios complexos em soluções técnicas eficientes.
  • Orientar equipes em projetos de alta complexidade e contribuir para o crescimento técnico de colegas.
  • Compromisso com a entrega de soluções de alta qualidade e impacto mensurável.
  • Habilidade de apresentar insights técnicos a públicos técnicos e não técnicos de forma clara e objetiva.
  • Proatividade para propor soluções novas e superar desafios técnicos.

Diferenciais:
  • Familiaridade com modelos pré-treinados como Google Vision AI, AWS Textract ou Azure Cognitive Services.
  • Conhecimento em técnicas avançadas de PNL para análise e organização de textos extraídos.
  • Experiência com implantação de soluções OCR em ambientes de produção e escaláveis, incluindo nuvem (Azure, AWS, Google Cloud).
  • Certificações relevantes, como Microsoft Certified: Azure AI Engineer Associate ou Google Cloud Professional Data Engineer.

O Grupo L'Oréal está presente em mais de 150 países em cinco continentes. Há mais de 115 anos, a L'Oréal se dedica exclusivamente a um único propósito: criar a beleza que move o mundo. Com um portfólio internacional de 38 marcas diversas e complementares, o Grupo gerou vendas no valor de 43.48 bilhões de euros em 2024 e conta com mais de 90 mil colaboradores em todo o mundo.

Como líder mundial de beleza, nos dedicamos a quebrar as barreiras de inclusão social para potencializar toda a pluralidade da nossa sociedade, especialmente no Brasil. Temos a missão de representar toda a diversidade brasileira e seguimos com nosso compromisso de sermos uma das empresas mais inclusivas do país, inspirando o Grupo por meio da nossa pluralidade, e impulsionando uma transformação em todo o mercado e na sociedade.

Gostaria de fazer parte da maior empresa de beleza do mundo?

Convidamos pessoas com deficiência a cadastrarem seus currículos em nosso Banco de Talentos. Este banco serve como um repositório para futuras oportunidades e não representa uma vaga em aberto atualmente. Seu currículo será avaliado e, caso seu perfil corresponda às nossas necessidades futuras, entraremos em contato para dar continuidade ao processo seletivo.

Essa é a sua chance de dar o próximo passo na sua carreira e fazer parte de uma empresa global, líder em beleza, que valoriza a inovação, a diversidade e o desenvolvimento de seus times!

Sobre a área:

A área Comercial da L'Oréal opera como um pilar central para o sucesso de suas marcas e clientes, conectando a inovação de seus produtos ao mercado consumidor. A equipe é composta por profissionais estratégicos na criação de planos de negócio e identificação de oportunidades, analíticos na interpretação de dados para otimização de estratégias, criativos no desenvolvimento de soluções inovadoras e orientados a resultados para impulsionar a performance e o crescimento.

A colaboração entre esses perfis é essencial para o sucesso, fomentando parcerias com clientes para o crescimento mútuo e permitindo a atuação com os produtos mais inovadores do setor de beleza em um ambiente dinâmico.

Principais atribuições

2.Aplicar MPOS das marcas, assim como serviços, objetivando a melhor visibilidade em cada PDV atendido.

Who Are We?

Decentralized Masters is at the forefront of DeFi education globally. In just two years, we have grown from a pioneering pair of co-founders to over 75 dedicated professionals. Today, we are recognized as one of the fastest-growing enterprises in the sector, with industry insiders predicting our evolution into a unicorn company by 2030. Operating on a bootstrapped model, we are on track to achieve an impressive $50 million in revenue this year alone.

Our Impact

While our growth has been remarkable, we take even greater pride in the success of our clients. To date, we have empowered over 2,000 investors to break into the DeFi world. At Decentralized Masters, we don’t just offer education; we cultivate a powerhouse of knowledge combined with an engaging community, innovative technology, and a team of leading DeFi and blockchain experts. Our commitment is to deliver unparalleled resources designed for long-term success in the world of DeFi and Web3, ensuring our members not only safeguard but also enhance their financial future.

Our Vision

Our goal is to create the largest and most influential DeFi ecosystem the world has ever seen, starting with becoming the gold standard in DeFi education. This vision is ambitious, transformative, and poised to change the landscape of digital finance.

Are You Ready?

This is more than just a job; it’s an opportunity to shape the future of Web3 technology and education. Are you ready to be part of our vision to redefine what’s possible in DeFi and beyond? Apply below, and let’s explore this journey together.

Check us out here: Decentralized Masters

What will you be doing?

We are seeking a Virtual Assistant (VA) to support our sales team by managing daily tasks in our CRM (Customer Relationship Management) system and ensuring accurate lead tracking and reporting. This role is ideal for someone who is detail-oriented, reliable, and comfortable working in a fast-paced, remote environment.

You will help keep our sales process organized by maintaining clean data in our CRM (HubSpot), ensuring leads are assigned correctly, supporting team communication, and updating key reports and trackers.

Key Responsibilities:

Lead & CRM Management

  • Enter and update new lead information in the CRM system
  • Assign leads to the appropriate team members based on defined criteria
  • Merge and clean duplicate contact records
  • Reassign leads that are not being followed up on
  • Ensure all lead records are complete and accurate

Sales Reporting & Tracking

  • Record daily sales activity metrics (calls, conversations, appointments set)
  • Maintain and update performance dashboards and spreadsheets
  • Track the movement of leads through different stages of the sales process
  • Send daily summaries and updates to team leads

Data Quality & Auditing

  • Perform routine checks of CRM data to ensure accuracy
  • Identify and correct missing or inconsistent lead data
  • Support monthly data audits to ensure clean reporting

Team Communication & Support

  • Monitor team channels (primarily Slack) and assist with lead-related requests
  • Support appointment setters and sales reps with lead follow-ups
  • Keep internal communication logs and trackers up to date and organized

Lead Follow-Up Support

  • Launch follow-up sequences for older leads who haven’t responded
  • Monitor high-priority leads and ensure they are being engaged

What do you bring?

  1. Please submit your resume in ENGLISH
  2. Native English speaker (or at least professional level)
  3. Must be available in EST time zone
  4. Experience in sales
  5. Hubspot knowledge and experience
  6. Prior experience working with a CRM (HubSpot strongly preferred)
  7. Strong written and verbal communication skills in English
  8. Comfortable using tools such as Slack, Google Sheets, and spreadsheets
  9. Highly organized and process-oriented
  10. Detail-focused with strong follow-through
  11. Able to work independently with minimal supervision
  12. Experience working as a virtual assistant or in a remote operations role
  13. Weekend availability is a must

What do we offer?

  • Competitive Salary
  • Fully Remote
  • Team Trips

title: Power Electronics Developer
description:
Select how often (in days) to receive an alert:

TechnipFMC is committed to driving real change in the energy industry. Our ambition is to build a sustainable future through relentless innovation and global collaboration – and we want you to be part of it. You’ll be joining a culture that values curiosity, expertise, and ideas as well as diversity, inclusion, and authenticity. Bring your unique energy to our team of more than 20,000 people worldwide, and discover a rewarding, fulfilling, and varied career that you can take in anywhere you want to go.

Job Purpose

About Us: At TechnipFMC, within the Controls & Automation product line, we are pioneering technology platforms for the electrification of Subsea Control Systems and the advancement of renewable energy sources such as offshore wind, hydrogen, and wave energy.

Our Team: The Electronics R&D team works across a broad spectrum of technologies, including analog electronics, FPGA, SoC, power design, safety design, motor controllers, processor design, and power line modems. These technologies are integral to various control system applications.

Your Role: As part of the Controls & Automation team at TechnipFMC, you will engage in the design, development, qualification, system integration, and production of new products, from commissioning to field operation. Our multidisciplinary development environment includes HW, SW, system, test, mechatronics, and production engineering teams working collaboratively.

We are seeking Senior Power Electronics Developers with expertise in motor control and battery management systems to join our Hardware development team.

Job Description

  • Define hardware requirements in collaboration with system, drive train, and battery management system architects and developers.
  • Design and develop motor drive and battery management circuits, PCBAs, and modules, including component selection, schematic drawing, PCB layout, and prototype building.
  • Conduct functional verification of motor drive and battery management system circuits, PCBAs, sub-assemblies, and electrical actuators.
  • Collaborate with systems architects, mechanical designers, PCB layout, manufacturing, reliability, and SW engineering teams to design and develop power electronics products.
  • Create test procedures and write test reports on functional, environmental, system operation mode, and manufacturing testing of custom power electronic designs.

You are meant for this job if:

  • Analog electronics, including discrete design with Opamps, transistors, inductors, transformers, and capacitors for high voltage designs.
  • Component selection of high voltage power semiconductors (IGBTs, MOSFETs, diodes) for gate drives and analog/digital measurement circuits.
  • Power electronics design across various topologies in the AC or DC domain for motor controllers, battery management circuits, power supplies, and switches.
  • Schematic design and PCB layout using ECAD tools like Altium Designer or equivalent.
  • Knowledge of motor drive and battery control topologies, semiconductor component performance, and loss mechanisms.
  • Experience with lab instruments such as oscilloscopes, network analyzers, signal generators, programmable loads, motor, and battery simulators.
  • Expertise in PCB layout for optimal component placement, reduced stray inductance/capacitance, improved manufacturability, and EMC compliance.
  • Knowledge of control algorithms and embedded programming for circuit design verification.
  • Experience in power electronics design optimized for DFX requirements (manufacturability and testability).
  • Understanding of EMC requirements and CE certification relevant to motor controller design in control system applications.

Qualifications:

  • BSc, MSc, or PhD in electronics, automation, cybernetics, or a related engineering field.
  • 3-5 years of industrial experience in relevant power electronics development and industrialization.
  • Ability to approach complex problems structurally.
  • Open-minded, professional English proficiency, and adaptability to work in a multicultural environment.
  • Continuously raising standards, innovative, and solution oriented.
  • Interest in electronics is an additional advantage.

What We Offer:

  • Engaging tasks and work-life balance.
  • Flexible working arrangements.
  • Training and career development opportunities.
  • Comprehensive insurance and pension plans.

Skills

Being a global leader in the energy industry requires an inclusive and diverse environment. TechnipFMC promotes diversity, equity, and inclusion by ensuring equal opportunities to all ages, races, ethnicities, religions, sexual orientations, gender expressions, disabilities, or all other pluralities. We celebrate who you are and what you bring. Every voice matters and we encourage you to add to our culture.

TechnipFMC respects the rights and dignity of those it works with and promotes adherence to internationally recognized human rights principles for those in its value chain.

Você é aquele tipo de pessoa que adora conversar, mas com propósito?

title: Process engineer specialist
description:
Process engineer specialist

6 days ago Be among the first 25 applicants

An Industrial Process Engineer here at Shape works closely with a multidisciplinary Agile team to build cutting-edge advanced analytics solutions. These solutions will generate insights from our connected data, enabling the team to advance the data-driven decision-making capabilities of our enterprise. This role requires a deep understanding of engineering, troubleshooting, and monitoring of industrial processes and equipment. They work closely with Data Scientists and Product Owners to ensure business value and quality.
Responsibilities

  • Act as the technical mentor and facilitator in the development of studies of process and performance for operational efficiency and compliance with the international standards for quality and safety.
  • Contribute to develop advanced analytics solutions for condition monitoring and performance optimization of industrial assets.
  • Compile and digest industrial technical documentation as operational manuals, datasheets and P&IDs to gather information that will be utilized as input for data-driven models.
  • Develop root cause analysis studies of industry failure events to identify new opportunities for development and improvement of Shape s portfolio of digital solutions.
  • Explore and develop mathematical modeling of industrial thermodynamic processes to support data-driven solutions development.
  • Explore historical time-series data of process equipments to validate hypothesis and test modeling techniques.
  • Implement Shape s digital products in new clients as well as supporting development of new features.
  • Problem framing: participate in problem framing together with business owners, data scientists and other engineers for identified opportunities.
Requirements
  • Degree in Chemical Engineering or a related field, with a deep understanding of process engineering theories and practices.
  • Proven experience in the Oil & Gas industry, with strong knowledge of industrial processes, operations, and predictive monitoring of critical assets.
  • Solid understanding of industrial systems and equipment, including practical knowledge of sensing technologies, protection systems, performance control, efficiency optimization, technical specifications, and common failure modes.
  • Hands-on experience with PI AF (Asset Framework) for data analysis and the development of predictive models, driving actionable insights and process improvements.
  • Expertise in asset performance and integrity management, with the ability to lead and facilitate structured engineering studies such as HAZOP, HAZID, RCA, FMEA, and RCM.
  • In-depth knowledge of industrial process operations and control, enabling the analysis of systems involving multiple interconnected pieces of equipment.
  • Basic knowledge of industrial automation, including Distributed Control Systems (DCS), dedicated protection systems, and condition monitoring technologies.
  • Technical familiarity with data collection and storage systems, including vibration data acquisition, PIMS platforms, and OPC servers.
  • Working knowledge of data analysis, machine learning algorithms, and digital software system architectures.
  • Experience with agile methodologies and tools for continuous improvement and process optimization.
  • Language: Advanced English proficiency.
  • Certification: CREA certification is mandatory.
  • To be available to work at our offices, in Rio de Janeiro and São Paulo.
Benefits

  • Health and Dental Plan: To ensure your care and well-being!
  • Flexible Benefit: Receive an amount that can be used according to your needs, including food, transportation, education, culture, and health. You decide how to use it!
  • Flexible Hours: Work at the best time for you and have a better quality of life.
  • Massages and Manicure in the Office: So you can relax and feel good about yourself.
  • Mentorship Program: Access development opportunities with the help of experienced professionals.
  • Gympass: To keep your health in check and take care of your body.
  • Snacks in the Office: Because everyone loves a snack at work!
  • Inclusive Environment: We value diversity and always strive to create a space where everyone can be authentic, respected, and feel part of something bigger.
  • Day off in Your Birthday Month: A day off in your birthday month to celebrate in any way you prefer
  • Extended Maternity/Paternity Leave: So you can enjoy this important time with your family, with peace of mind that your professional life will remain well-supported.
  • Childcare Assistance: To support you with the care of your young children.
  • Continuous Individualized Development Support: We offer support for your professional growth, respecting your personal needs and goals.
  • Culture and Well-being: We create an environment that values mental health, work-life balance, and encourages connection with culture.

Que tal fazer parte do nosso time como Pessoa Engenheira de Dados?
Sua missão será desenvolver e implementar soluções de dados utilizando sua experiência e habilidades em ferramentas e tecnologias como Airflow, Databricks, Python, SQL e Power BI.
Essa é uma oportunidade para atuar no modelo híbrido no Rio de Janeiro.
RESPONSABILIDADES E ATRIBUIÇÕES
Como Pessoa Engenheira De Dados, Você Focará Em

  • Visualização de Dados: Desenvolver dashboards interativos e relatórios personalizados utilizando o Power BI, para comunicar eficazmente insights e tendências de negócios aos stakeholders.
  • Otimização de Desempenho: Identificar e implementar melhorias de desempenho nos processos de dados, otimizando consultas SQL, ajustando configurações de pipelines e refinando modelos de dados.
  • Colaboração Interdepartamental: Trabalhar em estreita colaboração com equipes de negócios, desenvolvimento e outras áreas funcionais para entender requisitos de dados e garantir a entrega de soluções alinhadas às necessidades da organização.

  • Fortes habilidades analíticas e capacidade de traduzir requisitos de negócios em soluções de dados.

Who We Are
Boston Consulting Group partners with leaders in business and society to tackle their most important challenges and capture their greatest opportunities. BCG was the pioneer in business strategy when it was founded in 1963. Today, we help clients with total transformation-inspiring complex change, enabling organizations to grow, building competitive advantage, and driving bottom-line impact.
To succeed, organizations must blend digital and human capabilities. Our diverse, global teams bring deep industry and functional expertise and a range of perspectives to spark change. BCG delivers solutions through leading-edge management consulting along with technology and design, corporate and digital ventures—and business purpose. We work in a uniquely collaborative model across the firm and throughout all levels of the client organization, generating results that allow our clients to thrive.
We Are BCG X
We’re a diverse team of more than 3,000 tech experts united by a drive to make a difference. Working across industries and disciplines, we combine our experience and expertise to tackle the biggest challenges faced by society today. We go beyond what was once thought possible, creating new and innovative solutions to the world’s most complex problems. Leveraging BCG’s global network and partnerships with leading organizations, BCG X provides a stable ecosystem for talent to build game-changing businesses, products, and services from the ground up, all while growing their career. Together, we strive to create solutions that will positively impact the lives of millions.
What You'll Do
Join the BCG X Delivery team and immerse yourself in cutting-edge projects alongside our consulting units. Your role will be pivotal in employing data engineering methodologies to enhance the capabilities of both BCG Consulting and BCG X teams, across various domains. You'll be the go-to expert for data engineering, offering accelerated execution support to bring visions to life. Your collaboration will be key in understanding project requirements, leading the design, development, delivery, and support of solutions tailored to client needs. Expect to dive deep into tools and processes, ensuring the delivery of high-quality and efficient technology solutions. Whether it's short-term prototypes or long-term enterprise-grade developments, your contribution will significantly impact our project outcomes and organizational goals.
What You'll Bring
Technical Skills - Knowledge And Experience With

  • Unix-based command line & development tools
  • Version control (e.g. Git)
  • Python
  • Charting libraries (e.g. HighCharts, D3.js, Recharts, Plotly, Altair)
  • Cloud computing platforms (e.g. AWS, Azure, Google Cloud, etc.)
  • Containerization (Docker, Kubernetes, etc.)
  • Relational databases (e.g. PostgreSQL, MariaDB, MySQL, etc.)
  • NoSQL databases (e.g. MongoDB, Neo4j, Redis, etc)
  • Spark or other distributed big data systems (e.g. Hadoop, Pig, Hive, etc.)
  • Stream-processing frameworks (e.g. Kafka)
  • Data pipeline orchestration tools (e.g. Airflow, Prefect, Dagster, etc.)
Job Requirements
  • Fluency in Portuguese and English
  • Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Computer Science, a related field, or equivalent practical experience (graduation by December 2025 or earlier).
  • 6+ months of relevant internship or equivalent work experience.
Core Attributes
  • Harness Big Data tools and frameworks to fulfill specific requirements.
  • Implement ETL processes across diverse architectures, ensuring optimal performance and advising on infrastructure enhancements.
  • Collaborate with case and proposal teams to define analytics outcomes, select methodologies, and deliver unique insights.
  • Lead analytics modules, establishing trust through expertise in analytics and effective communication of findings.
  • Integrate learnings into new best practices, manage content confidentiality, and maintain stakeholder relationships for project security.
  • Guide junior team members, contribute to intellectual property, and conduct technical training.
  • Exhibit strong communication skills, both written and verbal, for clear message delivery.
  • Utilize analytical skills throughout the analytics lifecycle, providing advice and expanding knowledge in advanced analytics.
Additional info
Please apply for the positions equivalent to your previous work experiences. The seniority will be evaluated according to your experience and career structure at BCG X during the process. Even if you don't meet all these requirements, we encourage you to apply if this job description excites you.

Foco em ressarcimento OL (operação logística)

description:
Media Buyer & Ad Operations Success Manager (Remote)

Media Buyer & Ad Operations Success Manager (Remote)

MonetizeMore is a leading ad-tech company dedicated to empowering digital publishers to maximize their ad revenue through innovative technology and strategic partnerships. Our cutting-edge platform optimizes ad layouts, leverages header bidding, and integrates advanced analytics to drive superior results for publishers worldwide. Headquartered in Canada with a strong presence in the APAC region, we’re looking for a dynamic Commissioned Sales Representative to join our high-performing team and help publishers thrive in the digital advertising. ecosystem.
Job Overview
We are looking for a Media Buyer & Ad Operations Success Manager who excels in both programmatic/media buying and ad tech operations. This role is critical in ensuring the success of our advertising campaigns by optimizing media investments, managing ad tech infrastructure, and driving performance through data-driven strategies.
The ideal candidate has hands-on experience in media buying (paid social, programmatic, search, or video) and a deep understanding of ad serving, tracking, and campaign troubleshooting. You will bridge the gap between media execution and technical ad ops, ensuring seamless campaign delivery and maximizing ROI.
Key Responsibilities

  • Media Buying & Optimization:
    • Plan, execute, and optimize performance-driven media buys across platforms (Meta, Google, DSPs, etc.)
    • Manage budgets, bids, and targeting strategies to maximize campaign performance
    • Conduct A/B testing, audience segmentation, and funnel optimization
  • Ad Operations & Technical Management:
    • Oversee ad trafficking, tag implementation (Google Tag Manager, pixels, etc.), and QA
    • Troubleshoot discrepancies in delivery, tracking, or attribution
    • Collaborate with internal teams and vendors to resolve technical issues
  • Performance Analysis & Reporting:
    • Monitor KPIs (CTR, CPA, ROAS) and provide actionable insights
    • Generate reports and present findings to stakeholders
    • Ensure alignment between media spend and business objectives
  • Client & Stakeholder Success:
    • Act as a trusted advisor to internal teams or clients on best practices
    • Proactively identify opportunities for campaign improvement
What We're Looking For
  • Analytical Thinking - Ability to interpret data, identify trends, and make data-driven decisions
  • Technical Proficiency - Familiarity with digital advertising tools and platforms like Google Ad Manager, WordPress, GAM 360, traffic acquisition tool such sa Active Campaign and header bidding solutions
  • Problem-Solving Skills - Resourceful in identifying issues, troubleshooting errors, and finding effective solutions
  • Attention to Detail - Precision in setting up campaigns, implementing ad tags, or managing publisher configurations to ensure optimal outcomes
  • Communication Skills - Clarity in conveying technical details, results, and strategies to stakeholders with varying levels of understanding
  • Client-Centric Mindset - Strong focus on understanding client needs and providing personalized solutions to maximize client satisfaction
  • Knowledge of Ad Metrics - Understanding of key ad metrics like CPM, CPC, CTR, RPM, and ad yield optimization strategies
  • Strategic Thinking - Ability to think ahead and align short-term actions with long-term goals, including scaling performance
  • Sales Acumen - Skills to pitch ad solutions effectively, negotiate deals, and close partnerships with publishers or advertisers
  • Results-Oriented - Strong drive to achieve and exceed KPIs and revenue targets
  • Negotiation Skills - Confidence in negotiating with clients, vendors, and partners to secure the best outcomes for the business
  • Resilience - Ability to handle challenges and setbacks while maintaining motivation and a positive attitude
  • Data Visualization - Skills to create clear and impactful reports or dashboards to communicate performance and insights effectively
  • AI Fluency - Understanding and practical application of AI tools (e.g., ChatGPT, data enrichment tools, automated workflows) to enhance productivity, decision-making, and campaign performance
If you think you are a good fit to join the MonetizeMore team, please fill out the application. Also, give specific reasons on what sets you apart. We hire individuals, not robots so don’t be afraid to show a little personality ;)

title: Training Site Infrastructure Manager FIFA Women’s World Cup 2027TM
description:
FIFA27 will be established as the Local FIFA Subsidiary in Brazil, to work together with FIFA HQ in Zurich and globally, to deliver the biggest women’s sporting event in the world, the FIFA Women’s World Cup 2027 (“FWWC2027”).

Please submit your CV in English, as it will be reviewed by an international team.

Job Description

The position

The Training Site Infrastructure Manager reports to the FWWC27 Head of Infrastructure and Technical Services and FIFA Training Sites Manager, serving as a key member of the FIFA27 Tournament Infrastructure team in close collaboration with the Team Services, Team Facilities team and other stakeholders.
The successful candidate will ensure all deliverables align with FIFA’s exacting standards while optimizing operational efficiency and stakeholder satisfaction.

This position plays a pivotal role in the planning, development, and delivery of infrastructure at FIFA Women’s World Cup 2027 training sites across Brazil. Working alongside the FIFA Training Site Manager and in coordination with Team Services, Technical Services, Pitch Management, Venue Design, Dressing & Signage, Media Operations, Partnerships and external stakeholders (Training Site Authorities and Football Clubs), the role is responsible for ensuring all training sites are operationally ready and compliant with FIFA’s requirements and standards.

The ideal candidate brings a strong background in architectural and interior design, technical project management, stakeholder coordination, and large-scale international event delivery. As demonstrated through global events such as FIFA World Cups and Olympic Games. They will manage the implementation of training site upgrades, including renovations, overlays, and delivery of essential infrastructure, with a focus on strategic planning, design integration, and resource optimization.

Key responsibilities

  • Lead the design and infrastructure delivery strategy for all FWWC2027 training sites, incorporating best practices in venue planning, design management, and stakeholder engagement.
  • Coordinate the implementation of renovations and upgrades, overseeing construction quality, progress, and alignment with FIFA’s requirements and standards.
  • Manage the end-to-end lifecycle of overlay and technical service delivery, including scope definition, scheduling, procurement, installation, and handover.
  • Engage with Training Site Authorities, contractors, and internal teams to ensure seamless collaboration and delivery.
  • Implement project controls for budgeting, reporting, and risk mitigation.
  • Ensure sustainability, cultural alignment, and aesthetic quality across all training site environments.
  • Collaborate with cross-functional teams such as Pitch Management, Cleaning & Waste, Venue Design, and Dressing & Signage to ensure cohesive delivery.

Your profile

  • 10+ years of experience in architectural design, project management, and delivery of international sporting event infrastructure.
  • Proven track record in managing venue delivery and readiness, overlay operations, or major venue infrastructure for events like FIFA World Cup or Olympics.
  • Strong technical expertise in space planning, stakeholder communication, and procurement processes.
  • Bachelor’s or Master’s Degree in Project Management, Architecture, Interior Design, Engineering, or related field.
  • Proficiency in AutoCAD, BIM 360, MS Project, and other project management tools.
  • Strong analytical and problem-solving skills with the ability to assess and implement effective solutions.
  • Excellent negotiation and contract management skills.
  • Driver’s license
  • Right to work in Brazil.
  • Fluent in English (spoken and written)
  • Fluent in Portuguese (spoken and written)
  • Ability to re-locate to Rio de Janeiro.

About FIFA Women’s World Cup 2027

The FIFA Women’s World Cup is the greatest women’s sporting event on the planet, showcasing the best players in the world on the biggest stage. In 2027, history will be made as Brazil welcomes the tournament to South America for the first time ever.

This landmark event will unite the world through an unprecedented celebration of women’s football, inspiring billions of fans across the globe. As we prepare to host teams and supporters from every corner of the world, we’re looking for passionate, talented individuals to be part of history and help deliver an unforgettable tournament.

Join us and play your role in making FIFA Women’s World Cup 2027 a truly extraordinary experience that celebrates and elevates women’s football.

Join to apply for the Senior maintenance engineer rotating equipment role at Netvagas

As a Senior Maintenance Engineer, you will collaborate closely with the clients Maintenance Engineering, Planning, and Offshore Operations teams, as well as Shapes remote specialists, to implement and optimize data-driven maintenance strategies for critical rotating equipment in the Oil & Gas sector. Your role will focus on condition monitoring, technical data analysis, and providing actionable recommendations to enhance equipment reliability, availability, and operational performance.
We are looking for a technically skilled professional with strong experience in predictive maintenance and rotating machinery diagnostics, capable of working across multidisciplinary teams to support continuous improvement.
Responsibilities

  • Analyze inspection and test data, focusing on vibration analysis (including spectra) and lubricant analysis to detect early signs of equipment failure.
  • Diagnose equipment condition and recommend corrective and predictive maintenance actions.
  • Create work notifications and service orders (WO/Notification) in CMMS to ensure accurate execution of maintenance activities.
  • Evaluate intervention effectiveness by analyzing results and calculating avoided costs.
  • Develop technical reports and performance indicators related to equipment and maintenance strategy.
  • Maintain and update technical case studies in Shape Lighthouse, ensuring traceability and knowledge retention.
  • Collaborate integrally with offshore teams, client engineering and planning, and Shapes remote specialists.
  • Support continuous development and enhancement of predictive maintenance strategies.
  • Ensure operational integrity, safety, and compliance with industry standards.
Requirements
  • Bachelors degree in Mechanical, Mechatronics, or related fields.
  • Proven experience in predictive maintenance, reliability, and diagnostics of rotating equipment (compressors, pumps, turbomachinery, etc.).
  • Advanced skills in vibration analysis, spectra interpretation, and condition monitoring data.
  • Knowledge of lubricant analysis and interpretation of physicochemical and particulate parameters.
  • Familiarity with maintenance management systems such as SAP PM, Maximo, or equivalents.
  • Experience with asset monitoring systems like OSIsoft PI, SCADA, or similar.
  • Understanding of predictive, prescriptive, and condition-based maintenance strategies.
  • Desirable certifications in vibration analysis (ISO CAT II or higher) and lubricant analysis.
Differentials
  • Previous experience in offshore environments (FPSOs, platforms, refineries, etc.).
  • Knowledge of industry standards such as API, ISO, NR-13.
  • Experience with failure analysis methodologies (FMEA, RCA, RCM).
  • Intermediate to advanced technical English.

Nossos colaboradores encontram um ambiente acolhedor e com espaço para desenvolvimento. Traga seu talento e comprometimento e venha fazer parte deste time!

Responsabilidades:

  1. Auxiliar os alunos em suas metas, mantendo uma boa relação, ajudando-os a perceber que podem procurá-lo sempre que necessário para resolver questões relacionadas ao seu dia a dia na faculdade, como escolha de disciplinas, problemas ou queixas com docentes, ou outras demandas, contribuindo para atingir seus objetivos educacionais e de carreira, e fortalecendo nossa marca;
  2. Trabalhar em equipe com os professores, oferecendo orientação para cumprir metas e prazos acadêmicos, incentivando a participação em programas de capacitação, e realizando avaliações de desempenho e feedbacks, em parceria com o Coordenador Acadêmico de Curso, incluindo contratação e demissões de professores;
  3. Assegurar o cumprimento dos prazos dos processos acadêmicos, como lançamento de disciplinas, atividades de programas de experiências, entregas de documentação de estágio e TCC, além de supervisionar atividades de pesquisa e nivelamento;
  4. Colaborar na elaboração ou atualização do Projeto Pedagógico do Curso, garantindo a qualidade do ensino oferecido aos alunos;
  5. Gerenciar processos relacionados às avaliações do MEC, incluindo autorizações, reconhecimentos, renovações, além de fornecer informações para formulários de avaliação e do Censo Escolar do INEP.

Requisitos:

  • Experiência em docência, coordenação em outra IES ou cargo de gestão;
  • Graduação na área do curso a ser coordenado;
  • Preferencialmente, Mestrado ou Doutorado na área, conforme exigências dos órgãos de classe;
  • Desejável conhecimento em SIA (Módulo professor), aspectos regulatórios do MEC e na Lei de Diretrizes e Bases da Educação Nacional.

Informar carga horária ou outras informações importantes na divulgação.

Valorizamos a diversidade e a inclusão, e esta vaga é destinada a pessoas com deficiência (PCDs).

Sobre a Instituição:

Somos uma das maiores e mais respeitadas instituições de ensino do Brasil, com mais de 50 anos de história, presença nacional e reconhecimento pelo MEC. Nosso foco é transformar vidas por meio da educação, formando talentos e promovendo histórias de sucesso.

Missão e Valores:

Entregar a melhor experiência de aprendizagem, com foco em tecnologia, qualidade e inovação, sempre centrados no aluno. Valorizamos a meritocracia, diversidade, ética, inovação, simplicidade e o engajamento de nossos colaboradores.
